b.label: AARO / ORNL Synopsis: Analysis of a Metallic Specimen

edges.label: The privately held specimen passed from the company through the Army to AARO and then to ORNL
edges.note: AARO confirms the organisation 'negotiated an agreement in 2019 with the U.S. Army to analyze the samples' and that AARO subsequently acquired the sample with stakeholder permission. This is the only fully documented custody chain in the entire domain.

edges.label: Securities disclosure is why the TTSA arrangement is visible and a privately held prime's would not be
edges.note: TTSA's Reg A reporting obligations forced the CRADA into the public record. A privately held prime such as General Atomics has no equivalent obligation, which is the structural reason the documented case is a small company rather than a large one.
